verdict.rationale: Cursor's first-party docs describe Automations, which run cloud agents in the background on cron or preset schedules, or on events from GitHub, GitLab, Slack, webhooks and Linear. Setup is possible through the Agents Window, cursor.com/automations, the plain-language /automate skill, or templates. The docs also list managed always-on agents (Bugbot, Security Agents, PR Routing) and cloud agents that build, test, verify and open PRs autonomously. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled or triggered automations reliably maintain and fix software in practice.
